claude_proposed_widenings.name: species_lineage_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: This trait is a build-time choose-one branch that selects one of multiple mutually exclusive mechanical payloads. The current SpeciesTraitRecord can only carry one PassiveMechanics or one ActivatedAbilityMechanics payload, not a lineage picker over distinct payloads.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.mode = prepared_with_proficiency_bonus_free_casts
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Forest Gnome grants a normally prepared spell, allows a number of free casts equal to Proficiency Bonus, refreshes on a Long Rest, and still permits slot-casting. Existing grant_spell_access modes only cover once-per-long-rest and do not carry a scalable free-cast pool.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: stored_device_created_by_spell_option
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Rock Gnome creates a persistent Tiny device keyed to one chosen Prestidigitation effect, later activated by touch with a Bonus Action, capped at three concurrent devices, and self-expiring after 8 hours or a Utilize-action dismantle. That is not an existing passive or single activation payload.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device ... the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch ... You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action.
